claim and pause visibility do not require the authoritative assignment/SLA state needed by the action
audit mode omits explicit UNAVAILABLE states when transition history, job data, or SLA data is absent
submission summary omits Submitted At instead of showing UNAVAILABLE for the legacy read model
legacy audit rows omit authoritative actorRoleId and do not enumerate unsupported event evidence as UNAVAILABLE
the R3B ACK claims no owner, role, due date, or deadline is synthesized while the product code still synthesizes all three
